evidence.reason: At the pinned tip, the dispatch_pending recovery path computes saved_wt from result['worktree'] but only retains it when it equals the passed-in wt. A2 uses a separate suffixed checkout, so resuming an interrupted A2 dispatch with the original worktree skips retention of the recorded A2 worktree and marks the run failed. The pending_judge branch also bypasses the rung-2 worktree selection, so a deferred A2 judge can use the original A0/A1 worktree while the result still names A2. This is an existing resume/retention correctness bug, not a new requirement.
